pokedexEntries.su: Mega Kangaskhan’s strength derives from the mother’s happiness about her child’s growth. Watching it grow up keeps her spirits high.

pokedexEntries.mo: Thanks to Mega Evolution, its child grows. But as the child is good only at fighting and nothing else, its mother feels uneasy about its future.

pokedexEntries.us: The explosive energy the child is bathed in causes temporary growth. The mother is beside herself with worry about it.

pokedexEntries.um: When the mother sees the back of her Mega-Evolved child, it makes her think of the day when her child will inevitably leave her.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Its child has grown rapidly, thanks to the energy of Mega Evolution. Mother and child show their harmonious teamwork in battle.
